hypothesis: Whole-scene azimuth rotation may improve held-out target-direction transfer. Keep relative source geometry/content/noise clips paired; compare with a fixed-scene control, and test clean identity as a separate factor. This is a mature augmentation control, not a claimed innovation.
entry_gate: G4 major report, audit and completion archive saved
training_pool: Regenerate 2048 paired cases from G3 crop/noise-interval catalogue. Shared new multi-source directions and shared anti-clipping scale; rotate all speech/noise directions together. Exact reference-mic inputs and clean targets must match between paired pools.
extension_rule: Add only a complete four-cell seed block if projected 4 * largest completed run duration + 10-minute margin fits before training cutoff. Decision based on time, not metric outcomes.
fresh_confirmation: First three eligible new speakers with four complete 1-3.8s utterances each; exclude ALL G1/G2/G3 speakers and all previous source hashes. 12 sources, equal4 per speaker. No fallback to old discovery sources if retrieval fails.
validation: Six existing G3 validation sources, three per speaker by sorted ID; target -30/20/60, relative noise azimuth -80/+25 or multi8, OOFFICE 0dB, time125-175s. Same 54 cases for every cell.
selection: Same G3 validation SI-SDR with initial-STOI-minus0.005 gate, checkpoints every500; no WER selection
confirmation_conditions: Target -40/20/70deg; OOFFICE/PCAFETER; 0dB; point relative angles -80/+25 and multi8; noise clips250-295s. 216 noisy cases +36 clean cases per system. Point source angles are relative to target, not confounded across target changes.
test_use: Only after all training/checkpoint selection/report archives complete. All completed cells and seeds plus noisy/McNet; no best-seed selection; exact duplicate checkpoints may share inference but remain visible as systems.
